question: What chronological layer is directly assigned by the first-party publisher table of contents to the NLC 2024 article's reference [22], Liu Chenggan 《求恕斋日记16》 pp.321—322, and what may be concluded without directly reviewing those facsimile pages?
answer: National Library Press's first-party product page for the 18-volume 2016 facsimile edition gives a detailed volume-16 table of contents. In volume 16, the 1949 November section begins at p.321, December begins at p.335, and 1950 January begins at p.355. Therefore the NLC article's cited pp.321—322 are securely within the November 1949 diary section. This closes only the page-to-month chronology. The project has not directly reviewed pp.321—322, so the exact day, exact diary wording, actors, object list, transaction vocabulary, and any reference to the target 1823 Tonghu/Zhunzhai bound volume or catalog nos. 3482/3483 remain unresolved.
